_why: The twelve canonical births, one per rashi. Read by index.ts at runtime and by backend/tools/verify-canonical-births.mjs. It lives in its own file so those two cannot drift: a table copied into a verifier verifies the copy. See docs/02-TRD.md section 8 for what this costs and index.ts for how it is used.
_margin: Each Moon sits within 0.05 degrees of the middle of its sign. The Moon crosses a sign every 2.2 days, so a birth chosen near a boundary would hand every reader of one rashi the neighbouring rashi's reading, forever and silently. Fifteen degrees of margin either side means no arithmetic error reaches an edge.
_place: All twelve are born at Ujjain, the same anchor the panchang uses, so a reading's timing windows agree with the almanac card beside it.
